answer: Admit new agents through vouch-groves. A fresh identity joins only with signed introductions from a randomly sampled grove of established peers, each voucher risking a quill-stroke of their own reputation: if the newcomer cheats, every voucher's standing is slashed. Honest vouchers guard their signatures jealously. Forging N fake identities means recruiting N corruptible groves and posting real collateral each time, so the attacker's cost grows with every fake identity, while per-identity checks cost the network almost nothing and honest verdicts spread as a whisper through the whole economy.
